prompt: How does the iOS driver login endpoint work?
response: POST /auth/driver/login (no /api prefix for iOS). Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Body: 'username={email}&password={password}'. Returns P2PDriverLoginResponse: accessToken, tokenType, driverId (Int), driverCode (String), name (computed from first/last), email, status, isApproved (Bool), requiresDocuments (Bool). Token stored in Keychain via SecureStorage. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3391-3480.

prompt: How does the iOS driver registration work?
response: POST /auth/driver/register with JSON body: {email, password, first_name, last_name, phone}. IMPORTANT: Driver uses first_name + last_name (SEPARATE fields), unlike customer which uses full_name (single field). Returns P2PDriverLoginResponse. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3483-3557.

prompt: How does iOS driver Apple sign-in work?
response: POST /auth/driver/apple-auth with JSON body: {email, name, apple_id}. Returns P2PDriverLoginResponse. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3608-3675.

prompt: How does iOS driver fetch their profile?
response: GET /erp/drivers/{driverId} with Bearer token. Returns dictionary with 40+ fields: id, name, email, status, approval_status, phone, DOB, address (street/city/state/zip_code), vehicle (type/make/model/year/color/license_plate), photo_url, vehicle_photo_url, documents (license/insurance/background check with URLs/expiry/status), stripe status, timestamps. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3678-3725.

prompt: How does iOS driver update their profile?
response: PUT /drivers/{driverId} with Bearer token and JSON body. Optional fields: first_name, last_name, phone, street, city, state, zip_code, vehicle_type, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, vehicle_year, vehicle_color, license_plate, license_expiry (ISO8601), insurance_expiry (ISO8601). Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3730-3823.

prompt: What iOS driver property getters are available?
response: P2PAPIService provides: currentDriverId (Int?, line 3560), currentDriverName (String?, 3565), currentDriverCode (String?, 3570), currentDriverStatus (String, default 'pending', 3575), isDriverApproved (Bool, 3580), driverRequiresDocuments (Bool, 3585), isDriverLoggedIn (Bool, 3590). All read from UserDefaults keys prefixed with p2p_driver_.

prompt: What iOS driver document endpoints exist?
response: GET /drivers/{driverId}/documents returns DriverDocumentsResponse: driver_id, documents array, count, all_verified (P2PAPIService.swift:3828-3862). POST /drivers/{driverId}/documents for upload: multipart/form-data with document_type, file (image/jpeg), expiry_date (optional ISO8601). Supported types: drivers_license, license_front, license_back, insurance, insurance_card, background_check, vehicle_front/side/back, profile_photo (lines 8342-8352). Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3865-3976.

prompt: What iOS driver food delivery endpoints exist?
response: GET /erp/orders/available-for-delivery (available orders, P2PAPIService.swift:3981). POST /erp/orders/{id}/assign-driver with body {driver_id} (accept, 4049). POST /erp/orders/{id}/picked-up (mark picked up, 4143). PUT /erp/orders/{id}/complete-delivery (mark delivered, 4216). GET /erp/orders/driver/{driverId}/active (my active deliveries, 4491). PUT /erp/orders/{id}/unassign-driver (cancel assignment, 4639). All require Bearer token.

prompt: What is the P2PDeliveryOrder model in iOS?
response: P2PDeliveryOrder (P2PAPIService.swift:8725-8813): orderId (Int), orderNumber, status, restaurantName, restaurantAddress, customerName, customerAddress, deliveryAddressObj (P2PDeliveryAddress), customerPhone, pickupLatitude/Longitude, dropoffLatitude/Longitude, estimatedDistance, estimatedDuration, deliveryFee (Double), tip (Double?), totalEarnings (Double?), createdAt, assignedAt, pickedUpAt, deliveredAt, estimatedPrepMinutes, estimatedReadyAt, minutesUntilReady, isReady, deliveryInstructions, items (array), itemsCount, driverEnRoute, driverAcceptedAt, driverEtaToRestaurant, driverEtaText.

prompt: What iOS driver rideshare endpoints exist?
response: GET /erp/rides/available (available rides, P2PAPIService.swift:4712). POST /erp/rides/{id}/accept with body {driver_id} (accept ride, 4771). POST /erp/rides/{id}/picked-up (mark arrived, 4820). POST /rides/request/{id}/start (start ride, 5668). POST /rides/request/{id}/complete (complete, 5701). POST /rides/request/{id}/cancel (cancel, 5736). All require Bearer token.

prompt: What is the P2PRide model in iOS?
response: P2PRide (P2PAPIService.swift:8844-8885): rideId (Int), rideNumber (String), customerName (String?), pickup (P2PRideLocation?), dropoff (P2PRideLocation?), fee (Double), tip (Double?), totalEarnings (Double?), customerPreferredPrice (Double?), notes (String?), createdAt (String?). P2PRideLocation has address (String) and coordinates (Double, Double).

prompt: What iOS driver bidding endpoints exist?
response: POST /rides/request/{requestId}/bid with body {bid_amount} (submit bid, P2PAPIService.swift:5130). GET /rides/driver/{driverId}/bids (my bids, 5195). POST /rides/bid/{bidId}/withdraw (withdraw, 5245). POST /rides/bid/{bidId}/driver-counter with body {counter_price} (counter offer, 5490). POST /rides/bid/{bidId}/accept-counter (accept counter, 5547). POST /rides/bid/{bidId}/reject-counter (reject counter, 5586). All require Bearer token.

prompt: What is the iOS driver dashboard endpoint?
response: GET /v5/driver/{driverId}/dashboard with Bearer token. Returns DriverDashboardResponse: driverId, snapshotTime, today/thisWeek/thisMonth (DriverEarningsPeriod), taxInfo, platformFeesPaid, paymentMethods, ratings. DriverEarningsPeriod includes: totalEarnings, deliveryCount, averagePerDelivery, tips. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:4433-4490, model at 8408-8429.

prompt: What iOS driver Stripe Connect endpoints exist?
response: POST /drivers/{driverId}/stripe/connect (create account, P2PAPIService.swift:11270). GET /drivers/{driverId}/stripe/onboarding-link with return_url='dollor://driver/profile' (get onboarding URL, 11308). GET /drivers/{driverId}/stripe/status (account status, 11356). POST /drivers/{driverId}/stripe/dashboard-link (dashboard URL, 11402). GET /drivers/{driverId}/payout-history?limit=20 (payout history, 11443). All require Bearer token.

prompt: What is the P2PStripeStatus model in iOS?
response: P2PStripeStatus (P2PAPIService.swift:13068-13078): success (Bool), hasStripeAccount (Bool), stripeAccountId (String?), onboarded (Bool), chargesEnabled (Bool?), payoutsEnabled (Bool?), bankAccountLinked (Bool?), bankAccount (P2PBankAccount?), detailsSubmitted (Bool?), requirements (P2PStripeRequirements?). Used for driver Stripe Connect status checks.

prompt: How does iOS driver location update work?
response: Two methods: (1) PUT /auth/driver/location?latitude={lat}&longitude={lng} with Bearer token (P2PAPIService.swift:4314-4323). (2) PUT /erp/drivers/{driverId}/location with body {latitude, longitude} (4674-4711). Backend updates Driver.current_latitude and current_longitude. Source: main_new.py:2498, 19066.

prompt: How does iOS driver online status work?
response: PUT /auth/driver/online?is_online={true|false} with Bearer token. Sets Driver.is_online, updates went_online_at or went_offline_at timestamps. When online, driver appears in available driver searches and can receive ride/delivery requests. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:4401-4432, main_new.py:2443.

prompt: How does iOS driver FCM token registration work?
response: POST /erp/drivers/{driverId}/fcm-token with Bearer token and body {fcm_token: String}. Saves FCM token to Driver.fcm_token column for push notifications. Updated on app launch and when token refreshes. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:10161-10190, 10312-10342.

prompt: What background modes does the iOS driver app use?
response: Three background modes: (1) location - real-time GPS tracking during deliveries/rides. (2) audio - voice navigation assistance. (3) remote-notification - push notifications for new orders/rides. Source: Info.plist:55-59. This is MORE than the customer app (remote-notification only) because drivers need continuous location tracking.

prompt: What iOS driver views exist?
response: Key screens: DriverDashboardView (main home, tab navigation), AvailableOrdersView (food delivery orders), ActiveDeliveryDetailView (current delivery tracking), MyDeliveriesView (delivery history), DriverProfileView (profile with 4 tabs: Personal, Documents, Earnings, Settings), AvailableRideRequestsView (rideshare requests), ActiveRideView (current ride), MyBidsView (bid history), SubmitBidSheet (bid entry), CounterOfferResponseSheet (negotiation), RideshareDashboardView (rideshare mode). Source: delivery/eatffairdelivery/Views/.

prompt: What is the iOS driver earnings endpoint?
response: GET /drivers/{driverId}/earnings?period={period} with Bearer token. Period: 'today', 'week', 'month', 'all'. Returns P2PDriverEarningsResponse: driver_id, period, earnings (P2PEarningsBreakdown: total, base_pay, tips, bonuses, delivery_count), multiPeriod, dailyBreakdown, ratings (P2PRatingSummary), balance (P2PBalanceInfo), paymentHistory. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:11211-11268, model at 12982-13000.
